integrity: An exact symbolic identity, an analytic strict monotonicity argument and an adjacent-exchange proof establish the infinite-domain statements; a reproducible finite checker independently corroborates the algebra.
scientific_limitations: Infinite, randomly mating diploid population and exact deterministic allele frequencies
Fixed nonnegative dominance coefficient; only positive strengths favoring the same homozygote
For overdominance the classification covers two epochs, not arbitrary-length permutations
Historical novelty has not been independently certified; early technical literature was not available in full
title: A sharp dominance boundary for sorting epochs of diploid viability selection
